text.en: Atlas original design study for bones-and-joints: adult reference skeleton with grouped selectable regions; schematic long-bone, joint and repair specimens. Ideal static lever: external force W=0/10/20 N, distance L=0.15/0.30 m, angle θ=30/60/90/120 degrees from downward vertical, fixed perpendicular muscle arm r=0.04 m. Compute d=L sin θ, load torque τ=W d, equivalent muscle force Fm=τ/r. SIM: W20,L0.30,θ90 gives d0.30m,τ6N·m,Fm150N; L0.15 gives75N; θ30 gives d0.15m,τ3N·m,Fm75N. Twenty-four table rows are independently recomputed. Station offsets x=−2,+2,+4m are layout choices.
text.zh: 本主题的Atlas原创设计研究：成人参考骨架按区域合并点选；长骨、关节与修复标本为定性示意。理想静力杠杆：外加力W=0/10/20牛顿，距离L=0.15/0.30米，角度θ=30/60/90/120度（从竖直向下方向量起），固定垂直肌肉力臂r=0.04米。算法d=L sin θ，负载力矩τ=W d，等效肌肉拉力Fm=τ/r。模拟：W20、L0.30、θ90得d0.30米、τ6牛顿米、Fm150牛顿；L0.15时75牛顿；θ30时d0.15米、τ3牛顿米、Fm75牛顿。24行表值独立重算。工位x=−2、+2、+4米仅是排版位置。

note.en: Not human measurements or strength targets. Principles S16–S17; all constants are original DESIGN, not typical anatomical dimensions. Omits forearm/beam weight, varying muscle moment arm, acceleration, neural control and co-contraction. Table values remain defined in explore mode; mode only controls visuals and left-elbow override. Force-arrow display uses0.001m/N with0.20m cap; arrow direction is an ideal equivalent pull perpendicular to beam, not the biceps line. Poses are conservative design examples, not recommended range of motion. Geometry packet constants/glue are offered under CC BY-SA4.0; chapter prose is CC BY-NC-SA4.0.
note.zh: 不是人体测量或力量目标。原理见S16–S17；常数全是原创设计值，不是典型解剖尺寸。省略前臂及梁自重、变化的肌肉力臂、加速度、神经控制与共同收缩。探索模式仍能求出表值；模式只控制可视与左肘覆盖。力箭头按每牛顿0.001米画，最长0.20米；垂直梁的等效拉力不代表二头肌真实作用线。姿态是保守设计例子，不是建议活动幅度。几何包常数与胶水按CC BY-SA4.0提供；章节正文按CC BY-NC-SA4.0。
